sentences.text: It is a plant, specifically a tree or shrub with a height of up to 25 m; its status is LC (least concern).
In Mainz-Bingen, 27 reports were recorded in ten years, with the main time Ganzes Jahr.
Flowering occurs in Apr, with pollination by wind.
It is eaten by the European goldfinch and Musk beetle.
It serves as host to, among others, Turkeytail, Tinder Bracket, Dotted border, and Red-Belted Bracket.
